latest.title: 🚀 From Chaos to 360° Control: My Hybrid FinOps Strategy with AWS and Kiro Pro
latest.description:
The Challenge: Beyond the "Hidden Costs" Frustration 

In the cloud ecosystem, agility is a double-edged sword. Organizations often struggle with FinOps, sacrificing performance for savings or facing uncontrollable bills. In the trenches, I have learned that savings is an architectural habit, not a one-time event. It is about achieving operational symmetry between business requirements and cloud consumption, rather than simply turning resources off.

latest.title: Integrating AWS MCP Servers with Quick - Data Processing Example
latest.description: This article provides a comprehensive guide for extending Amazon Quick capabilities by integrating custom action connectors using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with Amazon Agent Core Runtime. It explains how to connect Quick to custom or third-party systems, using the AWS Data Processing MCP Server as a reference implementation. The solution enables natural language SQL queries over LakeHouse data and Glue Catalog awareness for autonomous schema introspection.

latest.title:
The Next Frontier in IAM: Manufacturing Identity Context
From "Who Are You?" to "Where Are You Coming From?" — Building Verifiable Network Perimeters with AWS VPC Endpoint Condition Keys
latest.description: IAM is shifting from who you are to where you're coming from. Since late 2025, AWS has released a set of powerful, and often misunderstood, IAM condition keys. deep on: aws:SourceVpc, aws:SourceVpcArn, aws:VpceAccount, aws:VpceOrgID, and aws:VpceOrgPaths.

latest.title: How I Used Amazon Quick to Run a Full Security Audit on My SaaS — and Fixed 11 Vulnerabilities in One Session
latest.description:
I've been building solo for a few months. 30+ serverless functions, 94 internal HTTP calls, and not a single deep security audit yet. I kept telling myself "next sprint."

Last week I finally did it, I used Amazon Quick Desktop to run a full audit. 15 minutes. 11 findings. 94 patches across 28 files in one session.
